title: search
description: Search the workspace for symbols, paths, or text. Composes lexical (ripgrep), structural (Tree-sitter), and LSP channels; reranks by intent, path proximity, freshness, authority, and graph centrality. Returns up to aci.search.default_limit (default 20); never exceeds aci.search.hard_limit (default 100).

query.description: Symbol name, qualified path, or text query.

scope.description: Optional path glob to limit the search scope.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Capped by aci.search.hard_limit.

continuation.description: Continuation token from a previous truncated search.
